plan.goal: Seed HepG2 cells in logarithmic growth phase onto the culture area of a 400 µm wide, 20 mm long channel.
plan.rationale: HepG2 (immortalized hepatoma, BSL-1) is seeded in logarithmic growth phase at the catalog-supported density of 50,000–100,000 cells/cm² (DSMZ ACC-180; ENCODE4 SOP). The channel culture area is width × length = 400 µm × 20 mm = 0.08 cm². At the low end of the range this gives 4,000 cells/channel; at the high end 8,000 cells/channel. A mid-range density (e.g. 75,000 cells/cm² ≈ 6,000 cells/channel) is a reasonable default for a confluent monolayer within the growth phase. Shear target for HepG2 is 0.05–0.15 Pa.
caveats: Channel height not specified by the user — assumed 100 µm for the chip geometry; confirm the actual channel height before perfusion.
Seeding density chosen at mid-range (75,000 cells/cm² ≈ 6,000 cells/channel); the defensible range is 4,000–8,000 cells/channel (50,000–100,000 cells/cm²).
Confirm the channel is a single channel (channel_count=1); if multiple parallel channels, multiply the per-channel seed count accordingly.
Verify the actual culture area in the lab (channel width × length) before seeding.
